item.title: Curiosities is officially out. I just let out a breath that I’...
item.description: Curiosities is officially out. I just let out a breath that I’ve been holding for three years. Some of these curious songs have been with me in voice memos and scraps of paper for even longer than that. Surreal that they are finally out in the world!A big, stumbling bear hug to the two people whose creative fingerprints are all over this record and made it better in a thousand ways: producer @ajminette and all around musical badass @twinkletones. Without AJ and Toni, these songs stay small, quiet things in my room. You guys launched them into space where they belong.The legend himself @michael_brauer_ graced this album with his world class mixing, and @plyman supplied the final touches of sonic alchemy in mastering.The artwork was beautifully illustrated by @oh_hai_ku.Huge thank you to the musicians who lent their talents to these nine curious songs:Guitars, mandolin, banjo, bass, vocals: @twinkletonesGuitars, synths, keys, bass: @ajminetteDrums: @kevinyokotaViolin: @luannehomzyCello: @yoshi.cellopright bass: @erikkertesAdditional vocals: @jamiethedrake, @trevornorthsoul, @boyjohnnyThe curiosity shop is open! Come on in, have a look around, and stay as long as you like. It’s yours now.

item.title: I very rarely cry, but the tears caught me off guard at the Curi...
item.description: I very rarely cry, but the tears caught me off guard at the Curiosities listening party on zoom tonight.Making an album is an elaborate and financially questionable way of saying, “Hey, you ever felt like this?” So something about seeing everyone’s faces in those rectangles, bobbing along to the music, couples swaying together, a dog popping into someone’s frame for “Roswell,” and all of them taking time out of their night to sit with me inside these little musical worlds of mine…it got me. So grateful for the overwhelming support and enthusiasm you guys have shown this album.Curiosities landed at midnight. It’s out! Open the doors and step inside. It starts with a fairytale.

item.title: HOLY MACKEREL YO GYS.I was feeling hopeful but maybe a little ne...
item.description: HOLY MACKEREL YO GYS.I was feeling hopeful but maybe a little nervous about reaching our Kickstarter goal in the allotted days. And then you funded it in less than three hours. WHAT?!?The love and support around this project has left me, for once, speechless. Launching the Kickstarter was like walking out onto a dark stage, and then seeing the immediate support pouring in felt like the house lights coming up to reveal a room full of friendly faces. “Thank you” doesn’t quite cut it here. But thank you all the same.Curiosities expansion plans are in order. More curious stuff incoming, musical and otherwise (see the Kickstarter for a more detailed update).Thank you for showing up for this project! 17 days left to preorder Curiosities on Kickstarter, and then the whole thing comes out on Friday the 13th next month. Can’t wait to share it with you.
